clips.prompt: A soccer player stands relaxed on the pitch between plays, shifting weight gently from foot to foot, arms loose at the sides, looking around.
A soccer player walks forward in a straight line at a steady relaxed pace, arms swinging naturally.
A soccer player jogs forward in a straight line at a steady medium pace, arms swinging naturally.
A soccer player sprints forward in a straight line at full speed, leaning forward, arms pumping hard.

A soccer player standing still takes one step forward with the left foot and kicks a ball hard with the right foot, swinging the right leg through with a full follow-through, then sets the right foot down and stands.
A soccer player jumps straight up and heads a ball with the forehead, snapping the neck forward, then lands on both feet.
A goalkeeper stands in a low ready stance with knees bent and both hands raised in front of the chest, bouncing lightly on the balls of the feet.
A goalkeeper dives sideways to his right, stretching both arms out toward the ball, and lands on his right side on the ground.
A soccer player runs forward and performs a sliding tackle, dropping onto the left hip and sliding feet first along the ground with the right leg extended.
A soccer player celebrates a goal by dropping onto both knees and sliding forward on the knees with both arms spread wide and chest out.
A soccer player celebrates a goal by jumping high into the air and punching the right fist upward, then landing.
A soccer player celebrates a goal by running around with both arms stretched out to the sides like airplane wings.
A soccer player stands and celebrates by forming a heart shape with both hands held in front of the chest, smiling, swaying slightly.
A spectator stands watching a match, swaying slightly and clapping hands now and then.
A spectator jumps up and down cheering with both hands raised high above the head.
A spectator stands and pumps the right fist into the air repeatedly, celebrating.
A soccer referee walks briskly forward in a straight line along the sideline, arms swinging naturally.
